paragraphs: Rabbah Tosfa'ah. Berakhot 50a. In the case of a woman whose husband had gone overseas, he ruled that the child born after twelve months was not a mamzer (Yevamot 80b). Rosh suggests that in this case both spouses acknowledged that the husband had not come home during those twelve months. He addressed Ravina as “master” in Mo’ed Katan 4a. He also spoke to Ravina in Yevamot 75b and Bava Kamma 119a. Rava Tosfa'ah spoke to Ravina: Shabbat 95a; Sukkah 32a; Zevahim 81b; Bava Batra 64a. He belonged to the end of the amoraic period, and it is said that he is called ‘Some say.’ See Part I: he headed the academy at Sura for six years after Rav Tavyomi's death, and died in 4234.
